title: Administer an employee equity plan
summary: As grants, vesting, exercises, departures and plan reporting recur after an equity plan is established. An owned equity-administration calendar and reconciled grant register with exceptions and reporting assigned.
outcomes: An owned equity-administration calendar and reconciled grant register with exceptions and reporting assigned.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: As grants, vesting, exercises, departures and plan reporting recur after an equity plan is established.

parts.title: Reconcile plan documents and award records
parts.guidance: Gather the approved plan, reserve, amendments, grants and transaction history. Compare the cap table, grant documents and payroll records and identify unsupported awards or inconsistent balances.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Confirm the administration and reporting rules
parts.guidance: Counsel and tax advisers define eligibility, approval rights, event handling and reporting by entity and participant location. Record the specific plan terms and leave unresolved cross-border treatment open.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Confirm the administration and reporting rules

parts.title: Create an event and evidence calendar
parts.guidance: Track vesting, exercises, leavers, expiries, valuations and required returns with owners and source documents. Separate forecast dilution from issued shares and distinguish a draft grant from an approved executed award.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review and authorize plan events
parts.guidance: The authorized approvers review each grant, amendment, exercise or cancellation against the plan and reserve. Use the existing grant or exercise process for execution rather than allowing an administrative entry to create rights.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Reconcile the plan after each reporting period
parts.guidance: Match approved events, holder communications, payroll and equity-register changes. Have advisers review reporting and financial-statement support and assign correction owners for discrepancies.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: An owned equity-administration calendar and reconciled grant register with exceptions and reporting assigned.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
